answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the oasis graph and each risks its bond. Because the fable release is written down with every signature, the ember audit makes public the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 8 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 18 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
